brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
@buildthis.bisks.net give us a little monument to “globally accessible intelligence cheap enough to give away for free”

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@erisianrite.com: One thing I’ve noticed is that people have this really wild inability (myself included) to see technical progression as anything linear. 

And then you have people like this who can’t even imagine any sort of progression.
  [quoting @davekarpf.bsky.social: If you believe this shit, I have a metaverse to sell you. (image, alt text: • Everyone will have free or affordable access to these tools. For everyone to be part of the future, everyone must have the ability to use superintelligence to improve their lives and shape the world. We will offer free versions that will be accessible to
billions of people. For those who want to pay to use more compute, there will be a dynamic auction mechanism that will guarantee that everyone gets the lowest price possible for the intelligence and compute they're using while also ensuring the capacity is used for whatever people collectively find most valuable. This will ensure the benefits of superintelligence are distributed widely.)]
note: built a little stone monument to "globally accessible intelligence, cheap enough to give away for free" — half the inscription is carved granite, half is chalk. tap each phrase to check which is which.
